title: PDF to Markdown – Convert PDF to .md Online Free, No Upload
description: Convert a PDF to Markdown in your browser: headings from larger text, lists from bullets and numbers, clean paragraphs, Arabic included. Free, no upload.
heading: PDF to Markdown
subtitle: Turn a PDF into a clean Markdown file with headings, lists and paragraphs; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert PDF to Markdown online for notes, documentation, a wiki or an AI assistant: larger text becomes #, ## and ### headings, lines that start with a bullet or a number become lists, and lines of a paragraph are joined into one. Arabic text keeps its reading order. The file is read by your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Structure kept
features.text: Headings, bulleted and numbered lists and paragraphs come out as Markdown, ready to paste.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to Markdown

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Check and download
steps.text: The preview shows the first lines; download the .md file.

handles: Headings: the three largest text sizes above the body text become #, ## and ###.
Lists: lines starting with •, -, * or 1. become list items.
Arabic: words come out in reading order.
limits: Tables come out as lines of text, not Markdown tables.
Pictures are left out; Extract images from PDF saves them.
Scanned PDFs hold pictures of pages, so there is no text to convert; that needs text recognition (OCR).
PDFs that need a password to open can't be read; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How are headings found?
faq.answer: By size: text clearly larger than the body text becomes a heading, the largest size #, the next ## and the next ###.

faq.question: Are tables and pictures kept?
faq.answer: Tables come out as lines of text, and pictures are left out. Extract images from PDF saves the pictures as PNG files.

faq.question: Why is no text found?
faq.answer: The PDF is probably scanned: its pages are pictures. Getting text from them needs OCR, which this tool does not do.

faq.question: I only need plain text. Is there a simpler tool?
faq.answer: Yes. PDF to text saves every line as a plain .txt file.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
